# hdtSMP64 (Faster HDT-SMP) plugin API

`PluginAPI.h` and `PluginOwnerAPI.h` are the public plugin interface of
[DaymareOn/hdtSMP64](https://github.com/DaymareOn/hdtSMP64), copied verbatim.
They are distributed under the accompanying [GPL-3.0 license](LICENSE) and
[exceptions](EXCEPTIONS).

The copy comes from the unmerged `feat/external-hair-owner` branch (interface
version 2.1.0, based on `dev` at `ec996db`), which adds mesh owners and frame
listeners to the 2.0.0 interface. Replace it with the header from the released
hdtSMP64 version once that change is merged upstream.
